# The RG DS Plus's own Linux (ANBERNIC-rk3568-keys): its built-in mapping puts the
# face buttons by their letters; here by position, as GBA DS reads them (a bottom,
# b right, x top, y left, as on ROCKNIX). Raw buttons: 0 A (right), 1 B (bottom),
# 2 Y (left), 3 X (top), 6 SELECT, 7 START, 13 HOME (8, BACK, is GBA DS's
# home_button, set by launch.sh); L1 / R1 (4 / 5) and the triggers are guesses
# until a Map Buttons run on the device (Settings) replaces this line.
